Checked addition with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
Checked subtraction with require(b <= a) underflow guard.
Checked multiplication with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) guard.
Checked division with require(b > 0) guard.

edges.reason: Owned constructor stores msg.sender into owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] by the requested amount.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
transferFrom consumes the caller's allowance allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and passes msg.sender to the external call.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner to call transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner to call transferAnyERC20Token.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for the check and later clears it.
acceptOwnership assigns owner = newOwner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Constructor sets symbol = COPE.
Constructor sets name = Copeland.
Constructor sets decimals = 4.
Constructor mints _totalSupply = 1000000000000000.
Constructor assigns the entire supply to the fixed deployer address in balances.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom calls safeSub on the source and the caller allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the destination.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed mapping.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes the allowance before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the spender-supplied contract address.
receiveApproval on the spender contract can call back into the token during the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into a caller-supplied token address.
The arbitrary ERC20 contract can reenter Copeland before the rescue call returns.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards tokens to the owner address.
First addend flows into the checked sum in safeAdd.
Second addend flows into the checked sum in safeAdd.
Minuend flows into the checked difference in safeSub.
Subtrahend flows into the checked difference in safeSub.
First factor flows into the checked product in safeMul.
Second factor flows into the checked product in safeMul.
Dividend flows into the checked quotient in safeDiv.
Divisor flows into the require(b > 0) guard in safeDiv.
New owner argument is stored in newOwner.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
Recipient argument determines the credited balance in transfer.
Token amount argument flows into safeSub/safeAdd in transfer.
spender indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens is the allowance value written by approve.
from indexes balances and allowed in transferFrom.
to receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
tokens is subtracted from source balance and allowance in transferFrom.
tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender is both approved and used as the external call target.
tokens is the approved amount and is forwarded to receiveApproval.
data is carried through approveAndCall to the external call.
Caller-supplied bytes are forwarded as calldata to the spender contract.
tokenAddress is the arbitrary target of the external rescue call.
tokens is the amount forwarded to the external token transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a only exists to feed the addition performed inside safeAdd.
Parameter b only exists to feed the addition performed inside safeAdd.
Parameter a is only meaningful as the minuend of safeSub.
Parameter b is only meaningful as the subtrahend of safeSub.
Parameter a is only meaningful as a factor inside safeMul.
Parameter b is only meaningful as a factor inside safeMul.
Parameter a is only meaningful as the dividend of safeDiv.
Parameter b is only meaningful as the divisor of safeDiv.
The only use of _newOwner is the newOwner assignment inside transferOwnership.
tokenOwner is used solely as the balance lookup key in balanceOf.
to is used solely as the credited account inside transfer.
tokens is used solely as the moved amount inside transfer.
spender is used solely as the allowance key inside approve.
tokens is used solely as the allowance value inside approve.
from is used solely as the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom.
to is used solely as the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens is used solely as the moved amount in transferFrom.
tokenOwner is used solely as the allowance mapping key in allowance.
spender is used solely as the allowance mapping key in allowance.
spender is both the allowance key and the external call target in approveAndCall; it is directly tied to the unsafe external call.
tokens is the approved amount forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
data is only forwarded as calldata to the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress is the arbitrary target of the unsafe external transfer call.
tokens is only the amount forwarded in the unsafe external transfer call.
